about: Optional card text for the .rfm1 files of Quixotic7/RemoteFM1FW (tools/fetch_fw_catalog.mjs, build_catalog.mjs --fw-catalog) that neither the Hub nor FM1VST's cores list, by the manifest's id: author (the short name), category, tag, what, site, beta. Everything else (id, name, version, licence, authors, source) is the file's own manifest. A firmware missing here gets category Other and a tag from its name. editors: the author's own editor page by catalog id, for a firmware the Hub lists without one (one with no editor also takes the editor of another entry with the same repo). An editor of null: none at all, over the Hub's, RemoteFM1FW's and the same-repo one (a firmware with no editor service: Hortator, whose ed_service() is a stub until its M5). ports: the USB MIDI port name by id for a firmware RemoteFM1FW's catalog does not list (the site's own FIZZ: its fm1.toml usb_product).

clipper.author: isod89
clipper.what: A SLOOP-family firmware by isod89, built as its author intends (with the Hügelton icons, all rights reserved) to WebAssembly (.rfm1) and hosted here; it runs natively in the browser.
